name: Starsight Energy
product: Commercial solar and energy-as-a-service for businesses.
replicate: Capex-heavy energy services; not a pure software clone.

name: uLesson
product: Mobile learning app and curriculum for African secondary students.
replicate: Content plus distribution via schools/parents. Product cloneable; curriculum depth harder.
licences: CAC; education standards if school-integrated; NDPR (minors).

name: Rensource
product: Distributed solar solutions for commercial and industrial customers.
replicate: Hardware plus project finance. Capital intensive.

name: Jiji
product: Classifieds marketplace with strong Nigeria presence.
replicate: Classifieds software is commodity; liquidity and moderation are the moat.

name: SeamlessHR
product: HR, payroll, and workforce management SaaS for African enterprises.
replicate: HR SaaS is consultancy-buildable; compliance modules and payroll integrations are the work.

name: Husk Power Systems
product: Renewable mini-grids and rural power (Nigeria among markets).
replicate: Mini-grid capex. 2024 list showed $20M debt tranche; historical totals may be higher in paid databases.

name: Omnibiz
product: B2B e-commerce digitizing FMCG supply to informal retailers.
replicate: Needs inventory float and city-by-city sales density.

name: Konexa
product: Private renewable electricity trading platform in Nigeria.
replicate: Requires NERC private trading licence and grid access.
licences: NERC private energy trading; grid access; CAC.

name: Mono
product: Open banking APIs and account data infrastructure (acquired by Flutterwave Jan 2026).
replicate: API product buildable; bank partnerships and CBN open-banking compliance are the gate.
licences: CBN open banking framework; NDPR; PSSP as applicable.

name: Okra
product: Open banking API platform (shut down; historical funding).
replicate: Same class as Mono; bank access hard.

name: Carbon
product: Consumer lending, BNPL, and savings (formerly Paylater).
replicate: Crowded digital lending; licence and collections decide survival.

name: CredPal
product: BNPL / installment credit for consumer purchases.
replicate: BNPL crowded; credit risk plus merchant partnerships.

name: Umba
product: Digital bank and lending with Nigeria presence (also East Africa ops).
replicate: Neobank plus credit; multi-country licences. Include cautiously as NG-listed in StartupList maps.

name: Raenest
product: Payments and treasury for remote African workers.
replicate: Cross-border payroll needs licences and banking partners more than UI.

name: NowNow
product: Merchant and consumer wallet / POS-oriented financial services.
replicate: Crowded POS/wallet space; licence plus agent network required.

name: Tomato Jos
product: Tomato processing and value-chain development with smallholders.
replicate: Processing plants: not a software replica.

name: Paystack
product: Online payment gateway (acquired by Stripe in 2020).
replicate: Gateway quality was excellent and buildable by strong engineers; bank integrations still take time. Acquisition often cited around $200M.

name: Odyssey Energy Solutions
product: Financing and deployment tooling for distributed renewable energy.
replicate: Climate finance platform; capital markets access matters.

name: Field
product: Pharmaceutical supply chain and route-to-market for therapies.
replicate: Pharma distribution networks and cold-chain compliance dominate.

name: Afriex
product: Remittance and multi-currency transfers for African diaspora.
replicate: Remittance corridors equal licences plus liquidity.
licences: MSB abroad; CBN remittance rules; AML; NDPR.
